deleteExisting.message: Delete existing files in "{{path}}" before copying? Git metadata is preserved when the destination is already a repository.
deleteExisting.title: Delete Existing Files

dropOnTopExisting.message: The destination "{{path}}" already exists. Continuing will overlay the source on top of it. Existing files outside the source will be preserved.
dropOnTopExisting.title: Overlay Existing Directory

copyModeDescriptions.completeRepository: Clones the complete repository, including Git history and recursively initialised submodules, into a new destination.
copyModeDescriptions.filesOnly: Copies every hidden, ignored, untracked, and tracked file that is physically present, but excludes every .git entry. Symbolic links remain links.

destinationModeDescriptions.deleteExisting: Removes only the destination working tree. An existing usable .git is preserved; otherwise a fresh repository is initialised.
destinationModeDescriptions.dropOnTop: Keeps existing working-tree files, then overlays the source. An existing usable .git is preserved; otherwise a fresh repository is initialised.

errors.bareRepository: The destination at {{path}} has bare Git metadata. Local Copy requires a working repository.
errors.busy: Another copy or clone is already in progress.
errors.destinationChanged: The destination changed while copying. The operation has been aborted to protect your data.
errors.destinationExists: Complete repository copies require a new destination folder.
errors.externalWorktree: The destination repository has an external core.worktree that is not supported.
errors.featureDisabled: Local Copy is disabled. Enable it in Experimental settings to use this feature.
errors.filesystemFailure: Local Copy could not complete a filesystem operation at {{path}}. See the result log for details.
errors.gitFailure: Git could not prepare the Local Copy source or destination. See the result log for details.
errors.invalidDestination: The Local Copy destination is not valid: {{path}}.
errors.invalidSource: The Local Copy source is not valid: {{path}}.
errors.overlappingPaths: The source and destination must not contain one another.
errors.rollbackFailure: Local Copy could not restore the destination completely. Recovery data is retained at {{path}}; do not delete it. See the result log for details.
errors.submoduleUnavailable: The submodule at {{path}} is not checked out. Initialise it before copying.
errors.symlinkFailure: A symbolic link at {{path}} could not be preserved. The destination was not changed.
errors.unknown: Local Copy failed. See the result log for details.
errors.unsupportedFileType: The file at {{path}} is a socket, device, FIFO, or another unsupported type. The destination was not changed.
